name: CS Fresh (Cold Storage)
description: Full-format supermarket with fresh produce, butchery, ready-to-eat sushi, bakery, and wine section.
tips: Evening discounts on ready-to-eat items and sushi typically start after 20:30.

name: Lentor MRT Station (TE5)
description: Direct sheltered underground linkway to Thomson-East Coast Line (TEL).
tips: Exit 1 connects directly into Lentor Modern Mall B1.

name: Guardian Pharmacy
description: Health supplements, over-the-counter medicine, personal care, and beauty products.
tips: Pharmacist on duty on selected afternoon hours.

name: Minmed Clinic
description: General practice family clinic, vaccinations, health screenings, and CHAS subsidies.
tips: You can book queue numbers online via the Minmed app before walking down.

name: Toast Box
description: Traditional Nanyang coffee, kaya toast sets, laksa, and curry chicken.
tips: Fastest breakfast option right by the mall drop-off.

name: MindChamps Preschool / Childcare
description: Premium early childhood education and infant care centre.
tips: Dedicated secure drop-off zone for parents.
